citations.finding: Michael Bloomberg's net worth is $64.2 billion per Forbes, making him the eighth wealthiest American at the time.
The bottom 38% of households (~47.8 million households, ~125.7 million people) had collective net worth of $11.4B per the Federal Reserve SCF, so Bloomberg's wealth is nearly six times theirs.

PolitiFact's independent replication with a University of Michigan economist found the bottom 38% had about $6B (vs. Bruenig's $11.4B), which still verified that Bloomberg had more wealth than the bottom 38% of households combined.
The figure originated from Bernie Sanders's Feb 19, 2020 debate statement "Mike Bloomberg owns more wealth than the bottom 125 million Americans," matching the claim's wording and date.
Jacobin's article presents the same underlying analysis (SCF-based bottom-38% figure) as the People's Policy Project piece, so S1 and S3 are not independent.
